rows.text: `v` = 0 when the virtual `[[rcx]+0x130]`(`rcx`) returns non-zero in `al`, else float `+0xC` of qword `[rcx+0x30]`; then over four 0x40-byte records from `rcx+0x90` (floats a `+0`, b `+4`, c `+8`, d `+0xC`, dword `+0x14`, qword `+0x30`; `rbx` = record + 0x28) it multiplies `v` by: b when d equals 0 or is unordered (`ucomiss`); otherwise, when qword `+0x30` is non-null, `007AE260`(`rbx`, 1.0 - c/d) * (a - b) + b if a > b (ordered `comiss`), else `007AE260`(`rbx`, c/d) * (b - a) + a; and when that qword is null, `007A9E50`(c/d, dword `+0x14`) * (b - a) + a; it returns `v` multiplied by float `+0x64` of `rcx`
